_comment: SIEGE LOSS STAKES - the bank-theft bounds (owner ruling 2026-08-27, WO-1026). LOOTABLE: wood, iron, stone(=the balance internally named Food), coins. UNTOUCHABLE: crystals, SKR, purchased goods, equipped gear.
_ownerPending: THE FLOOR AND THE CAP ARE PROVISIONAL AND AWAIT AN OWNER RULING. The 2026-08-26 ruling REQUIRES a protected floor and a per-attack cap but gave no numbers, and the retired 2026-08-21 pair (15% steal / 20%-of-capacity floor) belongs to a DELETED system and must not be reused as a default. Every number below is a placeholder chosen to be conservative (a siege stings, it never empties a store); changing them needs NO recompile [WO-1331 CORRECTION, 2026-09-02 -- READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING THE PHRASE ABOVE: 'no recompile' has NEVER meant 'no rebuild'. Assets/Resources IS COMPILED INTO THE PLAYER and LocalJsonCatalogSource resolves Resources FIRST on every platform, so editing this file still costs a full Unity player build (~10 min APK / ~30 min WebGL) before it reaches a device -- and editing the StreamingAssets twin alone changes nothing at all. That is the axis the owner actually cares about, and it is why every past 'move the numbers into JSON' fix did not solve what she was asking for. WO-1331 landed the remote catalog seam (CanonicalJson.Source / RemoteCatalogOverrides) that finally makes a rebuild-free retune possible; it ships FLAG-GATED AND OFF (ff.catalogremote). THIS FILE IS ON THE WO-1331 REMOTE ALLOWLIST, so once the seam is armed and a row exists it can be retuned without any build. See docs/reference/TUNABLE_LEVER_INVENTORY.md section 2.].

_authoringNotes.cappedResources: wood / iron / stone read their ceiling from TownBankCapacity.MaxOf, so their floor and cap are FRACTIONS OF CAPACITY - which keeps the sting proportional across the six container levels (2000 -> 34000) instead of 17x-ing on a late player.
_authoringNotes.coins: Coins are UNCAPPED BY DESIGN (TownBankCapacity.UncappableResources, owner ruling 2026-08-04), so a fraction-of-capacity floor is undefined for them. They use the two FLAT numbers below instead.
_authoringNotes.outcome: A HELD defence takes NOTHING - that is structural, not a knob, and there is deliberately no field for it here. Only a breach or an overrun bills.
_authoringNotes.unknownCapacity: A capped resource whose capacity reads <= 0 is treated as UNKNOWN and takes NOTHING. Fail-open in the player's favour: a capacity read that broke must never be able to empty a store.
